rationale: M49.J3 reviewer wave: 'org' and 'com' are NOT meaningful stdlib roots — com.sun (JDK) vs com.mycompany (user) differ completely — so fully-qualified third-party calls like org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils.readFile(...) MUST emit user-call edges (the C5 root-only mechanism kept the bare org/com roots, silently dropping every FQ third-party call). True stdlib roots (java.*, System) stay filtered, and the oracle JAVA_STDLIB_ROOTS set is mirrored lockstep in differential.ts.

expectRelationships.comment: com.acme user service — unqualified, but pins the user-call path
FQ third-party call — was silently dropped by bare 'org' root pre-J3
FQ slf4j call — bare 'org' root also dropped this pre-J3
